sections.title: SECTION 1: MATCH EACH DEFINITION ON THE LEFT (1-5) WITH THE CORRECT WORD FROM THE LIST ON THE RIGHT. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: describing something that causes strong feelings of thankfulness or joy
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): touched / touching

questions.text: to make a formal request for a job or education opportunity
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10): apply = to ask for something, usually in writing

questions.text: being able to cause someone to believe something is true
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): convinced / convincing

questions.text: the number of people in a class or at an event
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8): attendance = the number of people who go to an event

questions.text: belonging to a nearby area
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14): local = relating to the area around you

questions.text: subjects taught in school, college, or academy
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: curriculum = subjects taught in school, college, or academy

questions.text: separate from the other people or things in a group
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: individual = separate from the other people or things in a group

questions.text: to make someone more likely to do something
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: encourage = to make someone more likely to do something

questions.text: a test, usually scientific, done to learn something
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: experiment = a test, usually scientific, done to learn something

questions.text: a meeting to see if someone is suitable for a job or position
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: interview = a meeting to see if someone is suitable for a job or position

questions.text: a fixed amount of money received by an employee
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: salary = a fixed amount of money received by an employee

questions.text: to begin a relationship as a husband or a wife
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: marry = to begin a relationship as a husband or a wife

questions.text: only for one person or specific group
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: private = only for one person or specific group

questions.text: making you feel worried and nervous
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-A (p.8) Ex.2: stressful = making you feel worried and nervous

questions.text: to control a group of people
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10) Ex.2: manage = to control a group of people

questions.text: to be told some information
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10) Ex.2: hear = to be told some information

questions.text: to plan or arrange
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10) Ex.2: organize = to plan or arrange

questions.text: to think about carefully
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10) Ex.2: consider = to think about carefully

questions.text: to direct your attention or effort toward a particular activity
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10): concentrate = 集中する

questions.text: in or to a foreign country
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10): abroad = 海外へ・海外で

questions.text: to say that you are not satisfied with something
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10): complain = 不平・文句を言う

questions.text: extremely interesting and attractive
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): fascinated / fascinating

questions.text: extremely unpleasant or unacceptable
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): disgusted / disgusting

questions.text: making you feel pleased by providing what you need or want
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): satisfied / satisfying

questions.text: not as good as you had hoped or expected
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): disappointed / disappointing

questions.text: making you feel fear or anxiety
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): frightened / frightening

questions.text: making you feel in need of rest or sleep
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12): tired / tiring

questions.text: a plan of events or activities
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: program = a plan of events or activities

questions.text: to go to an event
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: attend = to go to an event

questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: charity = an organization that gives money, food, or help to people who need it

questions.text: very good, large, or amazing
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: incredible = very good, large, or amazing

questions.text: the ability or capacity to make oneself do difficult things
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: willpower = the ability or capacity to make oneself do difficult things

questions.text: to have an effect on a situation
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.2: make a difference = to have an effect on a situation

sections.title: SECTION 2: CHOOSE THE BEST ANSWER TO EACH QUESTION. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: John: Hey, Maria. How have you been?
choices: Maria: I've been doing well. I can't consider.
Maria: I've been doing well. I can't concentrate.
Maria: I've been doing well. I can't complain.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.13) Expressions: 挨拶に対する決まり文句「Can't complain.」

questions.text: What have you been up to lately?
choices: I haven't been doing so well.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.10) Focus: 具体的に取り組んでいる行動を現在完了進行形で答える

questions.text: Hey, Tony. Where have you been?
choices: I've been studying abroad since three weeks.
I've been studying abroad for two hours.
I've been studying abroad for two years.
questions.explanation: 期間には for を使用し、長期の所在を尋ねる文脈に合致するもの

questions.text: Hey, Jill. What have you been up to lately?
questions.explanation: apply to colleges (大学に出願する) が適切なコロケーション

questions.text: How are you doing today?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.13) Expressions: あまり調子が良くない時の返答「I've seen better days.」

questions.text: We need to buy this book! I'm _________ it will make us rich.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-1: 人（I）が「確信している」感情・状態を表すため過去分詞形の convinced を使います。

questions.text: I love popping bubble wrap. It's so _________!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-2: 物事（It）が満足感を与える性質を表すため現在分詞形の satisfying を使います。

questions.text: I was excited to see the movie. But after watching it, I was a little _________.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-3: 人（I）が「がっかりした」感情を表すため過去分詞形の disappointed を使います。

questions.text: That movie was so good! I was really _________ by the ending, too!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-4: 人（I）が結末に「感動した」ことを表すため touched を使います。

questions.text: I had to give a presentation to the class. I was so _________ to talk in front of everyone.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-5: 人（I）が「怖かった・怯えた」感情を表すため frightened を使います。

questions.text: OK. This hike is really _________. Can we take a break?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-6: ハイキング（This hike）が人を疲れさせる性質を表すため tiring を使います。

questions.text: What do you mean you don't like kangaroos? I think they're _________ animals.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-7: 動物が「魅力的である」という性質を表すため fascinating を使います。

questions.text: You don't have to eat the ice cream if it's so _________. Just throw it away.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.12) Ex.2-8: アイスクリーム（it）が「気持ち悪い・まずい」性質を表すため disgusting を使います。

questions.text: He _________ studying since 3:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.11) Grammar: 三人称単数（He）の現在完了進行形は has been + -ing です。

questions.text: I've been living in South Korea _________ ten years.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.11) Grammar: 期間（ten years）の前には for を用います。

questions.text: Phil _________ his studies well recently.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.11) Ex.6-3: 現在完了進行形の否定文は has/have not been + -ing の語順にします。

questions.text: Marcus _________ a music festival lately.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.11) Ex.6-4: 現在完了進行形 has been organizing を使います。

questions.text: I've been thinking that I need to _________ more on learning a second language.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-B (p.11) Ex.8-4: concentrate on ～（〜に集中する）が文脈に合致します。

questions.text: Lauren and I have been attending a summer program, and I _________ of the time!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.15) Reading: lose track of time（時間の感覚を忘れる）の表現です。

questions.text: How's life?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-C (p.13) Expressions: 「How's life?」に対するポジティブな返答「Couldn't be better!（最高だよ！）」
